external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Varna University of Management (VUM) is a private university in Bulgaria focused on business, management, hospitality, tourism, culinary arts and software technologies. Its English-taught programmes attract international students looking for a practical degree, Erasmus+ opportunities and, on selected routes, the option to earn an additional British degree from Cardiff Metropolitan University.
VUM provides student accommodation options in Varna and Dobrich and also publishes partner accommodation options in Varna, including Campus 90 Student House and Campus Oslo 4U.
